scope: Noise sensitivity of exposed processed-library phase recovery; no real distant-source likelihood
noise_definition: Independent Gaussian noise per processed wavelength sample; sigma equals broad-window centered spectral RMS divided by contrast_snr
pairing: Same unit Gaussian draw across SNR values and overlapping wavelength windows for each seed
fixed: Same 269 targets, 2210 comparison spectra, object exclusion and median-of-five-distinct-objects estimator
interpretation: Contrast SNR is not photon or survey SNR; no physical probability assigned to these noise levels
